Lemma
[Nondegeneracy of a Tuple via its Leading Principal Minors]

↗ lem:nondegenerate-tuple-gram-matrix

Let $G_j$ be the Gram matrix of the prefix $(v_1,\ldots ,v_j)$. Then $(v_1,\ldots ,v_n)$ is nondegenerate if and only if \[ \det G_j\ne 0\qquad (j\leq n). \]

Proof

↗ lem:nondegenerate-tuple-gram-matrix \sketch Apply Lemma 16.3 to every prefix.

□
